product.name: Morning Routine Planner
product.subtitle: Undated · The First Hour Decides The Rest

positioning.unit_of_planning: the first hour of the day
positioning.one_line: A fixed wake time, a sequence decided the night before, a short version written in advance for bad mornings, and a consistency tracker that shows within a fortnight whether you are running a routine or an intention.

primary: People who have started a morning routine three times
Shift workers rebuilding a wake time
Anyone whose day is owned by other people after ten

differentiators: Wake-Up Tracker records planned against actual, snoozes, and whether the phone was touched in the first ten minutes
A short version for bad mornings, written in advance rather than improvised
Body work and mind work separated, because they fail differently
Energy tracked hourly against sleep, so the routine's actual return is visible
Routine Consistency Tracker — one year of mornings, twelve rows of thirty-one days
Time blocking runs 05:00 to 20:00, not the standard 06:00
Add-nothing-for-two-weeks rule stated on the guide page
Four sizes, verified page and link parity

differs_from.017-evening-routine-planner: MUST NOT MIRROR. This product is forward-facing: waking, intention, preparation, energy. 017 is backward-facing: reflection, review, wind-down, sleep quality. The two share only the idea of a fixed sequence. Built as mirror images they would become a fifth overlapping pair, and the listings would be indistinguishable.
differs_from.013-habit-tracker: 12 carries two Morning Habits pages inside a general habit system. This is a morning system with a habit grid inside it.
differs_from.015-life-planner: 14 carries two Morning Routine pages as one life area among twelve.

compatibility.print: 100% scale, no bleed required, 100–120 gsm recommended
